reports.title: CONDENSED CONSOLIDATED INTERIM STATEMENTS OF COMPREHENSIVE EARNINGS (LOSS)

guidance.heading: ANNUAL OUTLOOK
section: Despite the Q3 blockade at Terronera and the temporary reduction in capacity at Guanaceví, throughput for the nine months ended September 30, 2026 was in line with guidance. Silver production was slightly below the lower end of the guidance range due to lower grades at Guanaceví, while gold production was slightly below the guidance range due to lower gold grades at Terronera during the first nine months of the year. Production of other metals was in line with guidance. Based on results to date and expected Q4 production, the Company is revising its 2026 silver production guidance at Guanaceví and narrowing the ranges of production in Terronera and Kolpa for a total revised range of silver production of 7.8 and 8.1 million ounces. The Company is also revising Terronera's gold production range while tightening the range at Guanaceví for a revised consolidated gold production guidance range of 42,000 - 43,500 ounces.

Revised Guidance | Previous Guidance
Terronera | Guanaceví | Kolpa | Consolidated | Consolidated
Silver Production | M oz | 2.5 - 2.6 | 2.9 - 3.0 | 2.4 - 2.5 | 7.8 - 8.1 | 8.3 - 8.9
Gold Production | K oz | 31.0 - 32.0 | 11.0 - 11.5 | – | 42.0 - 43.5 | 46.0 - 48.0
Silver Eq Production(1) | M oz | 5.3-5.5 | 3.9 - 4.0 | 4.5 - 4.8 | 13.7 - 14.3 | 14.6 - 15.6

(1)Silver equivalent for 2026 guidance is calculated using the following ratios: 90 silver oz to 1 gold oz; 45 silver oz to 1 lead tonne; 61 silver oz to 1 zinc tonne; 238 silver oz to 1 copper tonne.
